address: 61/11, 12 Rama 9 Road Soi 7, Huai Khwang, Bangkok, 10310, Thailand
bio: For an authentic Thai seafood experience, look no further than this restaurant named after the owner's fishing boat, which also catches most of the produce. Expect premium seafood cooking in the heart of Bangkok and hearty portions suitable for 4 or more people. The signature fried rice with salty fish is particularly noteworthy. We recommend any of the generously served dishes and also calling 2 days in advance to book a table and check on menu options....
